description: Pattern scanning and text processing language.

tip: Indicate the unambiguous end of options.

option.name: -f
tip: Read program text from program-file instead of from the command line.
Multiple -f options are allowed.

option.name: -F
tip: Set the field separator FS to value.

option.name: -v
tip: Assign value to the program variable var before execution begins.

option.name: -W
tip: Implementation-specific option, the equivalent of a long option.
Keywords may be abbreviated, e.g. -W v for -W version.
Several keywords can be combined with commas, e.g. -W dump,posix.

next.name: dump
tip: Write an assembler-like listing of the program to standard output and exit.

next.name: exec
tip: Read program text from the following file; this must be the last option.

next.name: help
tip: Show the usage message and exit.

next.name: interactive
tip: Set unbuffered writes to standard output and line-buffered reads from standard input.

next.name: posix
tip: Modify mawk's behavior to be more POSIX-compliant.

next.name: posix_space
tip: The original spelling of posix, deprecated.

next.name: random=1
tip: Call srand with the given seed, overriding auto-seeding.
Replace 1 with the seed you want.

next.name: sprintf=2000
tip: Set the size of the internal sprintf buffer in bytes.
Replace 2000 with the size you need.

next.name: traditional
tip: Omit features such as interval expressions that were not supported by traditional awk.

next.name: usage
tip: Show the usage message and exit.

next.name: version
tip: Write the version and copyright to standard output and the compiled limits to standard error, then exit.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Show the usage message and exit.

global_option.name: --version
tip: Show version information and exit.
